name: Tian Jing
source:
Tian Jing is a former princess of the Dilan royal family. A member of the Enclave Mage Council, Tian is a [url=https://vndb.org/c165758]Charlene[/url]'s right hand woman known for her composure. Recently, Tian has changed rather dramatically from a somewhat shy woman to a sexual predator. Rumours point to drug use or forbidden blood magic.

[In game description]
